name: Double-optimistic RAIN
tagline: Two Popov sub-steps with RAIN's exponentially-weighted anchoring; uses optimistic gradient predictions instead of an extragradient probe.

key_hyperparams.name: γ (bilinear / delta_nu)
key_hyperparams.role: exponential weighting base (halved vs RAIN to match 2x sub-steps)

init_recovers: RAIN baseline if d_i = g_i (i.e., g_prev = 0 throughout) and only one anchored step is performed.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces RAIN's single extragradient (g, w=z-τg) probe with two Popov / optimistic-gradient updates (d=2gₖ-gₖ₋₁) chained together inside the same call, while still anchoring each sub-step to the running weighted historical mean and updating S, F twice per step.

name: RAIN with grad-norm adaptive λ
tagline: RAIN where the anchor strength λ is rescaled by the relative growth of the gradient norm between consecutive iterations.

key_hyperparams.name: α (adapt)
key_hyperparams.role: scales the gradient-ratio modulation of λ

diff_from_baseline: Identical to RAIN except the anchor coefficient λ is multiplied by (1 + α·‖g‖/‖g_prev‖) every step, increasing anchoring when the gradient norm grows between iterations.

name: SEAG (no change)
tagline: Verbatim copy of the SEAG baseline: extragradient with anchor coefficient 1/(k+3).
diff_from_baseline: No real change — the proposal is bit-equivalent to the shipped seag baseline.

name: Tikhonov EG + tail averaging
tagline: Extragradient on F(z) + λz (zero-centered Tikhonov regularization) with iterate averaging started after `avg_start` steps; λ scales with σ on delta_nu.
init_recovers: SEG baseline at λ=0 with no averaging.
diff_from_baseline: On top of the SEG baseline, adds a zero-centered Tikhonov regularizer F(z)+λz inside both extragradient steps (with σ-adaptive λ for delta_nu), and outputs a tail-averaged iterate after a problem-specific warmup.
